exposure: dilation and curettage with hysteroscopic guidance (DCH)
Dilation and curettage under ultrasound guidance (DCUS)
Dilation and curettage with hysteroscopic guidance (DCH)
outcome: Undetectable serum human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels
finding: All five surgical treatments for CSP (DCUS, DCH, vaginal excision, laparotomy, and laparoscopy) had success rates between 89% and 100%, but vaginal excision was associated with shorter operative time and faster time to undetectable hCG levels.
